subject: Orchid Labs — competitive-scope & rate-floor escalation
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha@orchidlabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orchid SOW and commercial asks

Ben —

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning — Orchid is excited about the Dedicated APAC pilot. Procurement pushed back with a few commercial asks they say are blockers for procurement sign-off: 

- 12-month regional exclusivity for our APAC footprint (no other vendor allowed to target the APAC accounts covered by this SOW during the term)
- MFN clause tied to benchmark pricing: they want Redwood to guarantee Orchid will receive any better pricing we offer to comparable customers for the duration
- A rate floor / minimum monthly commitment: USD 50k/mo for the pilot months, and a blended discount of 40% in year 1

I’m attaching the SOW and their redlines (orchid_pricing_redlines.xlsx). Procurement asked for our commercial approval or a clean counter by EOD Friday — they have an internal QBR next Monday.

Attachment: Orchid_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: orchid_pricing_redlines.xlsx (xlsx)

Samantha Cole
Head of Procurement
Orchid Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orchid SOW and commercial asks — need deal desk + exec review

Folks — forwarding Orchid's procurement note. Key asks (TL;DR): 12mo APAC exclusivity + MFN tied to benchmark pricing + 40% first-year discount + $50k/mo floor.

Why I’m escalating: the exclusivity + MFN combo is high-risk for future commercial flexibility in APAC, and 40% with no commit floor beyond the stated MRC exposes us to margin risk. That said, Orchid is strategic for APAC expansion and the pilot could unlock additional enterprise deals in the region.

Proposed middle ground I’d like to get approval for (asks to execs/legal/finance):
- Convert 12mo exclusivity into a 90-day product-specific pilot exclusivity limited to the Named Accounts in the SOW (explicitly list accounts)
- MFN limited to the specific product SKU in the SOW and exclude public cloud marketplace offers and any pre-existing channel programs
- Limit discount to up to 35% conditional on a 12-month revenue commit OR a $600k minimum ARR guarantee for the first year
- Add a sunset and audit clause: Orchid must surface any allegedly better terms in writing and provide proof; any MFN payout limited to credit against future invoices (no retro cash payouts)

Can legal/finance confirm whether the above is acceptable as a controlled exception? If not, please propose alternative guardrails. I’d like to respond to procurement by EOD Friday.

Attachments: Orchid_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, orchid_pricing_redlines.xlsx

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Strategic 
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-09T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchid SOW and commercial asks — need deal desk + exec review

Ben / team —

Legal perspective: this is a high-risk ask as-is. MFN + exclusivity creates two problems: (1) it can lock pricing across the portfolio and hinder competitive pricing strategies, and (2) it creates discovery/audit burden that is operationally difficult to police. Specific concerns: 

- "Benchmark pricing" is vague in their redlines — we need a defined comparator set and explicit definition of what constitutes "better terms"
- Exclusivity must be narrowly scoped (product SKU + named accounts + explicit APAC geography). Don’t agree to language that prevents us from pursuing other APAC opportunities outside that scope
- Cap on retroactive liabilities: any MFN adjustment must be credits only, capped at a fixed dollar limit (suggest cap = lesser of 6 months of fees or $200k)
- Require a carve-out for public cloud marketplace and reseller/channel agreements

If the team wants to accept a time-limited exclusivity, we should convert 12 months to a 90-day pilot with an option to extend only if Orchid meets defined HT metrics (e.g., 3 expanded accounts signed within pilot). Also recommend including a mutual break clause if either party fails to meet SLA/usage thresholds.

I can draft redline language for the MFN and exclusivity carve-outs. If we are making an exception to standard terms above 30% discount or above the suggested liability cap, this needs explicit executive approval from Rishi.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchid SOW and commercial asks — need deal desk + exec review

I agree with Laura — material downside if MFN triggers broadly. Finance view / mitigations: 

- If we accept any scope of MFN, require a minimum commitment threshold (pref. $600k ARR or $7.2M ARR-equivalent for the contracted 12 months) or phased billing that front-loads recovery of acquisition costs
- Approve discount up to 35% only if Orchid signs a 12-month committed spend (non-cancellable) meeting the threshold above; otherwise cap discount at 20%
- Any MFN credit exposure should be prepaid credit-limited and amortized; no open-ended retro liability. Place an absolute dollar cap: $250k across the term as maximum MFN exposure

If we cannot secure commit or a higher MRC, recommend we decline exclusivity and push for a standard commercial pilot with a smaller concession (e.g., limited onboarding credits).

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-09T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: EXEC APPROVAL REQUEST — Orchid Labs limited exception proposal (EOD response requested)

Rishi —

Requesting executive sign-off on the controlled exception below so I can give Procurement a single answer by EOD Friday. Summary of recommended exception (compromise between GTM value and risk controls):

1) Exclusivity: 90-day pilot exclusivity limited to the named accounts in the SOW and to the Dedicated APAC SKU only. No broader APAC market exclusivity.
2) MFN: MFN limited strictly to the APAC Dedicated SKU in the SOW, excludes any public cloud marketplace or channel/reseller agreements. MFN remedies limited to invoice credit only and subject to a $250k aggregate cap.
3) Discount & Commit: Up to 35% discount contingent on a minimum $600k committed revenue for the 12-month period; if commit not met, discount reverts to 20%.
4) Audit & Sunset: Orchid must provide written proof of any claimed better terms; MFN claims expire 6 months after the relevant event.

If you approve this exception, legal (Laura) will issue redlines with the carve-outs and finance (Vivek) will draft the billing guardrails. If not approved, we’ll push back to procurement and offer a standard pilot with onboarding credits (no exclusivity / no MFN).

Please reply with Approve/Reject/Modify by EOD tomorrow so we can meet procurement’s timeline.

Thanks — Jordan
VP Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
